child → children：Several 后接复数，child 的不规则复数为 children。
kind → kindly：修饰 greeted，用 kind 的副词 kindly。

write → written：had never 后接过去分词，write 的过去分词为 written。

title: How to use your phone wisely
passage: A phone can be a useful tool, but good habits matter. Last month, Amy (1)____ that games were taking up her evenings. She had (2)____ hours staring at the screen instead of sleeping. She asked her parents for (3)____. Together, they made a simple (4)____. Now Amy (5)____ her phone outside the bedroom every night. During homework, she turns off messages to avoid (6)____. She can still use a dictionary app to (7)____ unfamiliar words. She also reminds (8)____ to take breaks. Since changing her habits, she has slept (9)____ than before and felt less tired in class. Using a phone (10)____ means making room for study, sleep and time with friends.

blanks.hint: realise → realised：Last month 明确过去时间，realise 用过去式 realised；美式拼写为 realized。
spend → spent：had 后接过去分词 spent，说明在意识到问题之前已花了时间。
suggest → suggestions：for 后需要名词；后文给出多条建议，suggest 变为复数名词 suggestions。
plan → plan：a simple 后接单数名词 plan，表示一份计划。
leave → leaves：Now 表示现在的习惯，单数主语 Amy 后用 leaves。
interrupt → interruptions：avoid 后接名词，关闭消息是为了避免打扰，可用复数 interruptions，也可用单数名词 interruption 表示打扰这一情况。
check → check：to 表示目的，后接动词原形 check。
she → herself：主语和被提醒的人都是 Amy，用 she 的反身代词 herself。
well → better：than before 明确比较睡眠改善情况，well 的比较级是 better。
wise → wisely：修饰 Using，说明使用手机的方式，wise 变为副词 wisely。
